name: AIP Conference Proceedings — September 2023
source: AIP Template(7).docx supplied by user; rules combine written guidance with DOCX style/section metadata. Strategy decisions: bottom margin uses 1.00 in; author email uses italic. Raw extracted metadata remains historical evidence.

rules.note: Safe fix sets the expected margin on every document section, then re-reads section OOXML and verifies the result.

rules.name: No page-number field
rules.evidence: Template summary says do not include page numbers.
rules.note: Safe fix removes only PAGE, NUMPAGES, and SECTIONPAGES fields from the document body, headers, and footers; surrounding content is preserved. The result is re-read and verified.

rules.name: Single line spacing throughout
rules.evidence: Template summary says line spacing should be 1.0 throughout.
rules.note: Direct paragraph spacing, paragraph styles and basedOn style chains are resolved from OOXML; auto line=240 is single spacing. The safe fix changes only affected paragraphs to semantic single spacing, then re-reads OOXML and verifies lineRule=auto with line=240. Empty paragraphs are ignored.

rules.name: No repeated internal spaces
rules.evidence: Repeated ordinary spaces between words are usually accidental.
rules.note: Checks eligible top-level prose only; table cells, equations and captions are excluded. The fix replaces only repeated-space ranges and preserves run formatting.

rules.name: No extra blank paragraphs between body text
rules.evidence: Empty paragraph nodes between body paragraphs are unnecessary when paragraph spacing provides document separation.
rules.note: Only safely removable, whitespace-only paragraphs directly between top-level body paragraphs are selected. Page/section breaks, manual breaks, fields, drawings, equations, bookmarks, numbering, tables, lists and non-body regions are excluded.

rules.name: Affiliation-email separator
rules.evidence: FormaScholar front-matter strategy: exactly one effective separator separates the last affiliation from the first author email. It may be one safe blank paragraph or one leading manual line break.
rules.expected: Exactly one effective separator (one safe blank paragraph or one leading manual line break)
rules.note: This is a FormaScholar consistency policy, not a literal requirement for one particular OOXML representation. Duplicate separators, multiple leading breaks, structural content, fields, drawings, page breaks, table content, positioned-layout paragraphs, and unreliable mappings require manual review.

rules.name: Extra blank paragraphs in front matter

rules.expected: No blank paragraphs except one between affiliations and author emails
rules.note: This is a structural consistency policy. Only safe empty paragraphs are removed; drawings, fields, equations, bookmarks, numbering, breaks, table content, positioned-layout paragraphs, and unreliable mappings require manual review.

rules.name: Abstract is present

rules.name: Introduction section is present

rules.name: Method or approach section is present

rules.name: Results or evaluation section is present

rules.name: Conclusion section is present

rules.name: In-text citations have a References/Bibliography section

rules.name: Major section structure is recognized
rules.evidence: The AIP template defines first-level heading formatting but does not require one fixed IMRaD sequence.
rules.note: Recognized section families are advisory. Combined headings such as RESULTS AND DISCUSSION satisfy both conceptual families.

rules.name: First-level sections use the Heading 1 paragraph style
